review_notes: Principal baseline selection: the authors’ H1 difference-in-differences family, full-sample all-firm columns in Tables 2–3 under Equation (11). Table 2 tests cooperation and its two 10-K count outcomes; Table 3 tests profitability, markups, and operating margins. These are the paper’s direct tests of H1. H2 patent-disruptiveness regressions (Tables 4–5) and H3 patenting/trade-secrecy regressions (Table 6), including tercile splits, are distinct hypotheses and are outside the selected family.

The paper identifies a difference-in-differences design but does not name the underlying estimator. Post timing is also stated at differing levels of specificity: Section 4.2.4 specifies four years before and after the act, while the table note says years following enactment and the stated estimation window is 1996–2005. The treatment of all years in that window is not clarified.

Table 1 reports summary statistics for the retained outcomes and controls but not separate descriptive rows for ln(#cooperation) or ln(#competition). The authors do not state zero-count handling for those log-count outcomes.
descriptive_reason: Table 1 provides descriptive statistics for four retained outcomes (excluding the two log-count outcomes) and all retained controls, plus Ln(delay) as an input to the Treatment × Post term. No separate summary row is reported for Ln(#cooperation), Ln(#competition), or the underlying cooperation/competition mention counts.
results_review_notes: Selected Table 2–3 all-firms H1 columns only; later hypotheses and subgroup results remain outside scope.
The underlying estimator, Post coding, count-zero handling, and some descriptive coverage remain unresolved in the source.
